cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. What time did we settle on for Mum's birthday dinner? I'm checking the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven, in the private room. You booked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Right. How have you written the restaurant name? I want everything consistent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't written anything. You're doing the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then could you proofread the booking confirmation aloud? I'll type straight from you so we don't introduce any errors.

mechanism: A hides forgotten dinner arrangements by treating retrieval of time and venue as an exacting proofread that only A is qualified to supervise.
confusable: A genuine information request admits uncertainty; A frames every question as checking other peoples precision and refuses B suggestion of forgetting.
comparison: Hike alternative masks missing route details as a briefing test; dinner alternative uses invitation consistency and source checking.
seedUse: Dinner booking, seven and confirmation derive from D30-a; S03 supplies precise verified-versus-estimated and venue-spelling corrections.
